verdict.rationale: Khoj docs claim self-hosting keeps data entirely on-device and offer a telemetry opt-out (khoj-docs-38, khoj-docs-21), which would prevent third-party model training on user data. However, independent community reports directly contradict the privacy framing: users note that chat (as opposed to search) routes through OpenAI's API with no stated guarantee data won't be used for training, calling the messaging 'disingenuous' and noting no promise personal data won't be sent to ChatGPT (khoj-comm-10, khoj-comm-11, khoj-comm-12, khoj-comm-15). Missing for 10: an explicit data-training opt-out/DPA for cloud/OpenAI-backed chat, and resolution of the community-reported gap between marketing and actual data flow.
